# `stream_usage_inject`

Injects `stream_options.include_usage = true` into streaming OpenAI chat-completions requests so the upstream response contains token usage.

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `max_body_bytes` | integer | no | Maximum request body bytes for `StreamBuffer` mode. The cap applies to every request traversing the chain, not only streaming chat completions. |

## Example

```yaml
filter: stream_usage_inject
```
